why: In each row the arrows turn a quarter turn clockwise from one box to the next (up, right, down; left, up, right). Row 3 has up-right and then down-right, so the first box must point up-left (a quarter turn before up-right). Option 2 points up-left. Options 1 and 3 point straight down or up.
trick: Find the turning step in a full row, then go backwards to fill a missing first box.
